name: Basic Volumetric Cone Lighting
aliases: Basic Volumetric Cone Lighting — First light ray, Volumetric raymarching loop
definition: A technique to render a volumetric light beam shaped like a cone originating from a light position and pointing in a specific direction, using raymarching in screen space.
summary: Basic Volumetric Cone Lighting is a post-processing technique that renders cone-shaped light shafts using screen-space raymarching and depth culling, distinguishing itself by avoiding secondary camera passes.
